description: This file defines the interface and configuration for different event notification mechanisms used in the lighttpd web server, including epoll, poll, select, kqueue, and Solaris-specific mechanisms. It declares structures, enums, and function pointers for managing file descriptor events.

methods.name: event_set
methods.description: Sets an event for a file descriptor.

methods.name: event_del
methods.description: Removes an event for a file descriptor.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls for events on file descriptors.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the event system.
